concerns.text: T012 (aggregator) and T013 (cleaner) are listed as implementation tasks, but T010 and T011 (tests) are placed BEFORE them. While the 'Tests MUST be written and FAIL before implementation' note exists, the task list order implies tests run before the code exists to fail. More critically, T015 (save raw data) and T016 (save validated data) are listed AFTER T014 (validation logic). The validation logic (T014) must execute to produce the validated dataset (T016). The current linear listing is ambiguous; T014 must explicitly precede T016 in execution order.

T020 (CLR transform) and T021 (descriptor computation) are prerequisites for T023 (XGBoost) and T024 (Linear Regression). However, T022 (VIF calculation) is listed between T021 and T023. VIF requires the computed descriptors (T021) as input. The order T021 -> T022 -> T023 is correct, but T025 (CV) and T026 (Bootstrap) depend on the trained models (T023/T024). The current list groups them loosely; T023/T024 must strictly precede T025/T026. T029 (Sensitivity) depends on T026 (Bootstrap) results, but is listed after T028 (SHAP). SHAP (T028) depends on the trained model (T023/T024), not necessarily on Bootstrap (T026), so T028/T029 ordering is flexible, but T029 must follow T026.

T035 (Partial Dependence Plots) and T036 (Sensitivity Plot) depend on the outputs of T028 (SHAP) and T029 (Sensitivity Analysis) respectively. T034 (Scatter Plot) depends on model predictions (T023/T024). The current list places T034, T035, T036 sequentially. This is acceptable, but T035 explicitly requires 'top 3 SHAP-ranked features' (output of T028). If T028 is not completed before T035, the task cannot proceed. The dependency T028 -> T035 is implicit but critical.

T005 (ingestion scaffolding) and T006 (features directory) are marked [P] (parallel). However, T007 (base data models) is listed after them. T005 and T006 create directory structures, while T007 creates the actual model classes. T005 (ingestion) will likely need to import the `SolderComposition` model (T007) to validate data. If T005 is implemented as a script that imports models, it cannot run before T007. The [P] tag on T005 is unsafe if it implies the script is runnable/complete before T007. T007 must precede any task that instantiates or validates `SolderComposition`.

T010 and T011 are marked [P] and placed before T012-T017. While TDD is a valid strategy, the task list format implies a linear execution flow. To avoid confusion, these should be grouped under a 'Test-First' sub-header or explicitly noted as 'Pre-requisite for T012-T017' to clarify that they are not dependent on the implementation code existing yet, but rather define the contract for it.
